issues.observed: The fuselage lacks the long, needle-like nose taper.
issues.proposed_change: Extend and streamline the nose area to match the reference silhouette.

issues.observed: The canopy is not set back enough from the nose.
issues.proposed_change: Reposition the canopy further back along the fuselage.
issues.target: Bubble canopy set back from the nose

issues.observed: Left intake is not oversized and lacks clear asymmetry.
issues.proposed_change: Increase the size of the left intake and emphasize its asymmetry.
issues.target: Single oversized air intake on the left flank only

issues.observed: Thrusters are not accurately placed on the centerline.
issues.proposed_change: Align the thrusters properly with the centerline.
issues.target: Twin rear thruster nozzles on centerline

issues.observed: The tall swept tail fin does not feature the required aft rake.
issues.proposed_change: Adjust the tail fin to include a swept and raked design.
issues.target: Tall swept tail fin with aft rake

issues.observed: The overall shape lacks aerodynamic tapering.
issues.proposed_change: Refine the fuselage shape to appear more aerodynamic and tapered.
issues.target: Streamlined one-person hover racer with a long tapered nose

issues.proposed_change: scale Fuselage main loft length by 1.30

metrics.method: deterministic matched-view silhouette, proportion, outline-detail and palette metrics; names and labels earn no credit

summary: The model exhibits several key elements from the brief but lacks detail and accuracy in execution. The overall silhouette and proportions are not as streamlined or aerodynamic as described. There are notable differences in shape and surface finish compared to the reference images.
